headline: Meta's Muse Could Upend All Kinds of Businesses. It Hasn't Yet
snapshot: Companies have spent the past several weeks trying to reassure investors that Muse and other AI agents pose more of an opportunity than a threat. The competitive question is whether this changes the model race, enterprise integrations or customer lock-in as major AI providers battle for durable platform advantage.
